mapper.sql: SELECT id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, order_date, expect_date, total_amount, paid_amount, status, applicant, approver, approved_at, received_at, remark, create_by, create_time FROM purchase_order WHERE del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order(id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, order_date, expect_date, total_amount, paid_amount, status, applicant, remark, create_by, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{orderDate}, #{expectDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{status}, #{applicant}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW())

INSERT INTO purchase_order_item(id, order_id, item_name, category, specification, unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, received_qty, remark, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{orderId}, #{itemName}, #{category}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{receivedQty}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET del_flag='2', update_time=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(status='draft') AS draft, SUM(status='pending') AS pending, SUM(status='approved') AS approved, SUM(status='received') AS received, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) AS total_amount FROM purchase_order WHERE del_flag='0'
